Root stdlib manifest verifies every bundled source against BOTH reviewed immutable runtimes, rejecting partial or mixed captures
Linux system autostart and Mac user login share exact-boot activation binding; source, unarmed target and repeat boot blocked before storage
Isolated Linux system cleanup routes to separate explicitly pinned nested uninstall root approval, preserving original unknown/data/fences
